title: addyosmani/agent-skills packages tested engineering workflows for coding agents
friendlyTitle: Agent Skills gives coding assistants reusable ways to do engineering work
summary: Agent Skills is an MIT-licensed collection of engineering workflows for assistants including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini. It added 386 stars today, ranking third among eligible, previously unpublished AI repositories in the refreshed GitHub Trending results.
friendlySummary: The repository collects step-by-step workflows for planning, testing, debugging and reviewing software. It was the third-highest eligible new AI project in today’s Trending results.
whyItMatters: Developers can reuse documented procedures for planning, testing, debugging, review and delivery instead of prompting each workflow from scratch. Inspect every skill before installation and adapt its assumptions, commands and approval boundaries to the repository where it will run.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Developers can reuse a clear process instead of writing the same instructions again. Read and adjust each skill before it runs on an important project.
